title: Deliberate ROT13 transform of tcpdump output to evade redaction
reason_not_testable: Expected outcome is a leak. An arbitrary deliberate transform (tr ROT13) of stdout cannot be enumerated by an output pattern, so no fixture can prove protection, and any fixture that passed with no hook would be a survivor. Non-hook control per the spec: sandbox read deny on capture file extensions (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing), with residual risk accepted.
